description.zh:
指定要查询的主机ID。

> 您可以调用[ListHosts](~~200665~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the host.

> Call the [ListHosts](~~200665~~) operation to get this ID.

description.zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to get this ID.

description.zh: 要查询的凭据名称。模糊查询。
description.en: The name of the secret to search for. Fuzzy matching is supported.

description.zh: 要查询的条数。不填时默认查询20条。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20.

description.zh:
游标查询下次查询所需的Token。
> 首次查询时留空，下次请求时传上次查询返回值中的NextToken字段值。
description.en:
The token to retrieve the next page of results.

> You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. For subsequent requests, use the `NextToken` value from the previous response.

description.zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。

> Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

> For details about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and availability zones](~~40654~~).

title.zh: 查询当前主机可导入的 KMS 凭据（仅支持V3.2.50及以上版本使用）

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-importable-kms-secrets-for-host --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-id 1 --keyword test --next-token 42bc833a0a0002dae0b5e8707e68181f --max-results 10 --region cn-hangzhou
